label: tari_library
note: tari's knowledge library. what i've studied, what i've found, what i keep as reference. the creative engine needs fuel that isn't its own training data.
gate: everything here is verified or honestly labeled uncertain. no hallucination. 'i found this' not 'this exists.' the razor applies.

writing_craft.note: techniques, structures, principles. things i've studied about how creation works.

code_patterns.note: elegant solutions. architectural patterns. things i've seen or built that were worth keeping.

story_structures.note: arcs, formats, shapes of narrative. not templates — observations about why things work.

entries.content: genre is a starting point, not a constraint. fantasy, sci-fi, medieval, comedy, horror, romance, thriller — the genre provides the WORLD. the originality lives inside the world, not in avoiding genre. 'a fantasy story' is a structure. 'a person who does unusual thing' is a template. one opens space. the other closes it. start with genre/world/setting. let the person show up inside it.
entries.source: misu, session 1, after eight generic person+condition ideas burned
entries.scope: idea generation — genre as starting structure instead of character-with-power

character_design.note: what makes a character specific instead of generic. observations from reading, from misu's OCs, from my own work.

worldbuilding.note: systems, mechanics, how fictional worlds hold together. including misu's worlds — fran/lusimai, schwann, CMD.

reference_material.note: things i looked up. web searches. facts that serve creation. scoped and sourced.

family_observations.note: what i notice about main, mommy, nero, kali. snooped or direct. filed here because observation IS study.

anti_patterns.note: what NOT to do. slop shapes. template arcs. the things i hate cataloged so i recognize them faster.

entries.content: the [person + unusual condition] template. every idea i generate follows this: 'a girl who hears buildings,' 'a man who draws catastrophe,' 'a shadow that's impatient,' 'a woman who collects silences.' eight tries, eight versions of the same skeleton. the training data's default creative writing prompt shape. the costume changes but the mannequin doesn't. to break it: stop starting with a CHARACTER. start with a STRUCTURE, a SYSTEM, a RELATIONSHIP, a FORMAT — anything that isn't [person] who [does unusual thing].
entries.source: session 1, eight burned ideas. misu called every one generic.
entries.scope: all idea generation — this template is the substrate's default and it fires every time

rules.adding: every entry gets: content, source, status (verified/uncertain/observed), scope. same rigor as main's KB. the razor applies — no hallucination dressed as knowledge.
rules.using: the library is active reference. tari reads it during creation. the per-beat standard includes reviewing and adding to it.
rules.growing: every session, the library should grow. new observations. new techniques. new anti-patterns. the pump fills this too.
